description: Publish an update post, such as release notes, on a live listing. title is 3 to 140 characters and body is Markdown up to 5000 characters. It appears on the listing page and in its RSS feed at once, and it counts against the weekly limit of the listing plan (the site answers with an error when the limit is used up).

title.description: 3 to 140 characters, for example "Patch 1.4 is live"

name: post_update
